item.title: Server for French Dinner Party
item.description:
25-50 USD/hr | I’m hosting a private, four-course French dinner for 8–10 guests and want the evening to feel seamless from the first canapé to the last glass collected. You’ll greet guests with passed appetizers, plate and present each of the four courses at the table, keep wine and water topped up, and quietly clear plates and glassware between courses and at the end of the meal.
The menu is already planned, there are no dietary restrictions to navigate, and all serving pieces, platters, and utensils will be on-site and ready for you—so you can focus purely on timing, presentation, and attentive service. Professional attire and a calm, polished manner are essential; knowledge of basic French dining etiquette is a plus.
Key moments I’ll look for: • Smooth pacing of courses without rushing or long gaps • Clean, well-set plates arriving consistently hot • Discreet clearing that doesn’t interrupt conversation • Kitchen and dining area left tidy with dishes washed or loaded in the dishwasher
Date and exact schedule will be confirmed once we connect. If you have relevant private-dining experience and can bring that restaurant-level polish into a home setting, I’d love to hear how you would approach the evening.

item.title: Experienced WordPress Developer Required
item.description:
25-50 USD/hr | am looking for an experienced WordPress developer to help maintain and update an existing custom WordPress website.
The site is built with a custom theme based on the 10up framework and uses:
Tailwind CSS v3
Advanced Custom Fields (ACF)
Gutenberg
Custom PHP/WordPress theme development
JavaScript
Git / npm build workflow
This is NOT an Elementor or page-builder project. I need someone who is comfortable working within an existing custom theme and understanding another developer's code before making changes.
The work will include ongoing layout and design changes, ACF/Gutenberg updates, responsive styling, troubleshooting, bug fixes, and occasional new functionality.
I am a web designer/developer and will provide clear direction, screenshots and specifications. I am looking for someone I can work with directly on an ongoing basis rather than an agency.
You should have strong experience with:
Custom WordPress theme development
ACF / ACF Pro
Gutenberg and custom blocks
Tailwind CSS, preferably Tailwind v3
PHP, HTML, CSS and JavaScript
Git and npm/build processes
Responsive development
Maintaining and troubleshooting an existing codebase
For your application, please provide examples of custom WordPress sites where you have worked with ACF, Gutenberg and Tailwind CSS. Please also tell me your experience working on custom themes originally developed by someone else.
I would like to begin with a small paid project. If we work well together, I expect to have ongoing WordPress development work available.

item.title: Engaging Jewelry E-commerce Build
item.description:
15-25 USD/hr | I’m ready to launch an online store for a curated line of jewelry and need a developer who can turn the concept into a polished, revenue-ready website. All product photos and short demo videos will be pulled from the manufacturer’s site; I’m already in the process of securing formal usage permission, so the build must make it easy to swap or update media later if any items change.
The site has a single goal—sell. From a clean product catalogue and zoom-ready galleries to a frictionless cart and secure checkout, every click should reinforce trust and elegance. I’m open to Shopify, WooCommerce or another mainstream platform if it speeds us to market, provided the final result is fully responsive, SEO-friendly, and simple for me to maintain after hand-off.
Key deliverables • Complete store setup with intuitive navigation and modern, mobile-first design • Product pages that showcase manufacturer-supplied images and videos without quality loss • Payment gateway integration and basic tax/shipping rules • Backend walkthrough so I can add or update items myself
Acceptance criteria: a live site that passes mobile and desktop performance audits, processes a test order end-to-end, and allows me to change a product’s media in under five minutes.

item.title: UK Website Ongoing Technical Maintenance
item.description:
18-36 GBP/hr | I’m looking for a new developer/company to provide ongoing technical maintenance and support for our established website, FreeWills.co.uk, which is operated by Quick Will Limited.
The website is built using October CMS/PHP and is hosted on Linode, with Cloudflare also in use. We are not looking for a redesign or redevelopment of the website. We need a reliable person/company to maintain the existing system and provide technical support when required.
Our requirements include:
* 24/7 automated uptime monitoring and alerts * Monitoring for HTTP 5xx/504 errors and other availability issues * Linode/server monitoring, including unusual traffic or resource usage * October CMS, PHP and database maintenance * Security and dependency updates * Cloudflare/DNS support where required * Backup monitoring and the ability to restore the site if necessary * GitHub/source-code and deployment support * Investigation of server/application errors when they occur * Reasonable response times for urgent issues affecting the live website * Occasional development/fixes, which could be charged separately if appropriate
We recently had an incident where the website returned 504 Gateway Timeout errors for approximately 16 minutes during a site crawl. Unfortunately, Google Ads attempted to access the website during this period and subsequently disapproved a significant number of our advertisements because it considered the destination unavailable. This has highlighted the need for appropriate monitoring and someone available to investigate these issues when they occur.
Our current developers have carried out substantial remediation and development work, so we would arrange a proper technical handover and provide access to the relevant systems and documentation.
We would like a quote for ongoing maintenance with additional development charged separately or another arrangement you would recommend.
Could you please let me know:
1. Whether you currently support existing October CMS websites; 2. Whether you are comfortable supporting Linode/Linux, Cloudflare, PHP and the associated server infrastructure; 3. What monitoring and emergency response you would provide; 4. Your typical response time if the live website goes down; 5. What would be included within a monthly maintenance package; 6. Your monthly cost; 7. Your hourly rate for work outside the maintenance package; and 8. Whether there would be any initial onboarding/handover charge.
The website is commercially important to us, so I’m looking for a long-term relationship with someone who can maintain the existing platform reliably, rather than someone looking to replace or rebuild it.
I’d be happy to arrange a call and provide further technical information if required before you quote.
Kind regards,
Amanda George Managing Director Quick Will Limited t/a Free Wills FreeWills.co.uk

item.title: UI/UX Designer – MudBlazor-First, Responsive Multi-Platform SaaS UI (Remote, AEST-Aligned) -- 2
item.description:
8-15 AUD/hr | I’m building a business-management SaaS platform using Blazor with MudBlazor as the component foundation, and I’m looking for a UI/UX designer to shape the entire user experience. There is a current front-end which would need to undergo an uplift.
The same design language must feel natural: • In a browser • Inside a desktop shell (e.g. .NET MAUI) • On mobile screens
Responsive, multi-platform thinking is required from the first wireframe onward.
This is NOT A Figma-only role.
Every design must be implementable in MudBlazor using Blazor-friendly CSS and design tokens.
What you’ll do • Translate existing user flows and rough sketches into: ○ High-fidelity mockups ○ Clickable prototypes • Design core system-defining screens, including: ○ A data-rich analytics dashboard (charts, tables, KPIs) ○ A flexible user profile area • Use these screens to establish: ○ Layout patterns ○ Navigation behaviour ○ Modals, dialogs, and settings conventions • Design responsive layouts for: ○ Web (desktop) ○ Tablet ○ Mobile (down to ~360px) • Apply CSS and theming to extend MudBlazor: ○ Typography ○ Spacing ○ Density ○ Visual hierarchy • Ensure designs: ○ Map cleanly to MudBlazor components ○ Avoid custom UI elements that fight the framework • Collaborate closely with developers and provide regular written status updates during AEST hours
Deliverables • Low- and high-fidelity designs for Web, Desktop, and Mobile breakpoints • A reusable design system aligned to: ○ MudBlazor variables ○ Typography and spacing rules • Handoff package including: ○ Component mappings ○ Color palette ○ Interaction notes ○ Responsive behaviour guidance
Acceptance criteria (examples) • No layout shifts at desktop, tablet, or mobile breakpoints • Dashboard charts, tables, and KPIs remain readable at 360px width • All core profile actions (edit details, password reset, avatar upload) complete in ≤ 3 interactions
Required experience (must have) • Proven UI/UX design experience for responsive SaaS applications • Strong CSS skills, especially in component-based systems • Hands-on experience working with Blazor • Strong familiarity with MudBlazor (or real Blazor + MudBlazor projects) • Experience designing within an existing component library • Ability to explain design trade-offs clearly • Availability overlapping AEST hours
Nice to have • Experience exporting design tokens from Figma / XD / Sketch • Familiarity with Material Design 2.0 • Experience designing data-heavy dashboards • Light Blazor / Razor component awareness
Compensation • AUD $8 – $15 per hour • Open to per-screen or milestone pricing
Short design validation task (unpaid, shortlisted only) Shortlisted candidates may be asked to complete a small, time-boxed design task. Not production work. Not used commercially. ≤ 2 hours. Example: • Design one responsive dashboard screen using MudBlazor • Show desktop, tablet, and mobile layouts • Map key elements to MudBlazor components • Include brief CSS/theming notes
How to apply To confirm you’ve read this: • Start your proposal with: MudBlazor + CSS • Share relevant work • Briefly explain how you design for responsive, multi-platform UI using component libraries
If you enjoy defining product-level UX that developers can implement with minimal friction, this role is for you.

item.title: Digital Communications & Social Media Specialist — Ongoing Execution Support
item.description:
50+ CAD/hr | Hello!
We are a Québec-based organization operating in the mining innovation ecosystem and are looking for a reliable, hands-on freelancer to support the weekly, and occasional day-to-day, execution of our digital communications.
This is primarily an execution role, not a strategy mandate. Our strategic communications direction, positioning, key messages and priorities are developed internally. We are looking for someone who can take clear direction and approved content and turn it into polished, timely digital communications with minimal supervision.
What you’ll do :
• Create, format, schedule and publish content across our social media channels, primarily LinkedIn and our Website; • Adapt supplied content into platform-appropriate posts while preserving the intended message and institutional tone; • Produce simple, professional visual assets using Canva or equivalent tools, based on our existing brand guidelines and templates; • Update and maintain website content through our CMS; • Support the digital promotion of programs, events, initiatives, calls for applications and organizational announcements; • Prepare and manage content calendars based on priorities provided by our team • Coordinate publication logistics, links, tagging, formatting and basic quality control; • Monitor published content and flag comments, issues or opportunities requiring internal attention; • Track basic digital performance metrics and provide concise reporting when required; • Handle occasional short-turnaround requests when organizational priorities change.
What we’re looking for :
You are someone who gets things done. You are comfortable receiving an objective and source material, asking the few questions that genuinely matter, and then moving efficiently to execution.
You have strong attention to detail, good editorial judgment and the ability to work independently without turning every task into a meeting or a lengthy process. You know when to make a reasonable execution decision yourself and when something genuinely requires approval.
Very strong written French (mother-tongue preferred) is essential, including the ability to work naturally in a Québec institutional/business context. Professional English is also required.
Experience with LinkedIn, Meta/Facebook, Canva and common website CMS platforms is expected. Experience with organizations in B2B, technology, innovation, economic development, industry or institutional environments is an strong asset.
How we will work together :
We provide the strategic direction, priorities, source material and necessary approvals. You provide the execution capacity that turns them into consistent, professional digital output.
We value:
• Reliability and follow-through • Responsiveness • Autonomy within a clear mandate • Fast, practical execution • Attention to detail • Good judgment • Clear and concise communication • Respect for deadlines and agreed deliverables
We are specifically looking for someone who can close the loop: When a task is agreed upon, we expect it to move from brief to execution to completion without repeated follow-ups.
Engagement :
This is intended to begin as a freelance engagement with the potential for ongoing work if there is a strong fit. Workload may vary depending on campaigns, events and organizational priorities.
To apply, please send:
• A short introduction focused on your hands-on digital communications experience • 3 to 5 examples of social media content you personally created or executed • Examples of simple branded visuals, if available • Your experience updating websites/CMS platforms • Your level of written French and English • Your availability and typical response time during business hours • Your hourly rate
Please also briefly answer this question:
"You receive approved source material and a clear communications objective for a LinkedIn post that needs to go live tomorrow. Walk us through exactly what you would do from receiving the brief to publication."
Many thanks!

item.title: Construction Website with Booking

We inspect and document physical damage, prepare construction estimates and supplemental repair information, send supporting documentation to the assigned insurance adjuster, and complete approved repairs. We do not provide public-adjusting services or negotiate policy coverage on behalf of customers.
Important features include:
* Modern, premium, mobile-friendly design * Home, Services, Projects, About, Service Areas and Contact pages * Insurance Restoration landing page * Detailed estimate and insurance-loss intake forms * Secure photograph and document uploads * Fields for insurer, claim number and assigned adjuster * Optional e-signature integration for company-provided AOB and work-authorization forms * Before-and-after project gallery * Local SEO for Aurora and surrounding Chicagoland communities * A system I can easily update myself * Complete ownership and administrator access at handoff
Please reply with:

Your experience collaborating with other freelancers. 5. Your availability and estimated completion time. 6. The tools or third-party services you would require. 7. Whether you are comfortable using shared files, designs and project checklists.
I will select one person as the lead developer so responsibilities, deadlines and final integration remain organized.

item.title: Shopify Store Optimization for Handcrafted alligator and cypress Goods
item.description: 2-15 USD/hr | About My Business: I run Pitres Handcrafted, faire etsy and .com selling 100% handcrafted goods, including hand-burned woodenware (like roux paddles and cutting boards), hand-stitched leather goods, and candles. Everything is made entirely by hand—I do not use CNC machines or automated lasers. My products are proven and validated: I recently did $10,000 this quarter on Faire and have over 100 sales on Etsy. However, my Shopify store is currently generating zero sales. The Goal: I do not want to build a completely new Shopify store from scratch. I need to keep my current theme but upgrade the UX, fix backend syncing issues, solve variant problems, and optimize my SEO so Shopify can become my central hub for both retail and wholesale. Scope of Work: 1. Multi-Channel Sync & Variant Troubleshooting Set up automated syncing between Shopify, Faire, and Etsy so inventory and orders are centralized on Shopify. Fix existing variant issues across all three platforms (Shopify, Etsy, Faire). I am specifically having trouble getting variants to sync and display correctly for items like my roux paddles. 2. Wholesale & Retail Integration Set up a B2B wholesale solution (like Wholesale Gorilla, Locksmith, or similar) on my Shopify store. I need the ability to manually approve wholesale customers so they can log in and see wholesale pricing, while regular retail customers see standard pricing on the same website. 3. Shopify Theme Cleanup & UX "Flairs" Reorganize my Shopify collections so they are logical, clean, and easy to navigate. Hide or remove unnecessary pages to streamline the buying process. Add visual upgrades and "flairs" to make the site more attractive and trustworthy without changing the core theme. Import my existing Etsy reviews into Shopify to build social proof. 4. SEO & Title Optimization Optimize product titles, meta descriptions, and tags across Shopify, Etsy, and Faire. Fix current title issues so products are named exactly what customers are searching for (e.g., focusing on descriptive, search-friendly keywords). 5. Product Photography Assistance Assist with auditing, organizing, and potentially updating product photos across listings to ensure they look cohesive and professional. Ideal Freelancer: You should be an expert in the Shopify ecosystem, specifically with B2B/wholesale apps, variant structures, and multi-channel syncing (Etsy and Faire). Strong SEO knowledge for both Shopify and marketplace algorithms is required.

item.title: Ongoing WordPress Blog Setup
item.description:

Here’s what I count on you for: • Publishing or updating posts I provide, checking formatting and links before they go live • Applying core, theme and plugin updates safely, with backups in place • Watching performance and uptime, then correcting anything that slows the site below a two-second load time • Carrying out basic security monitoring and acting fast if issues surface
If you also enjoy refining SEO, layout, or introducing useful features, that initiative is welcome.
Acceptance criteria • No broken pages or errors after updates • Consistent load times under two seconds on desktop tests • Scheduled content goes live on the agreed dates
When you reply, share examples of other WordPress blogs you manage, the tools you rely on—WP-CLI, Jetpack, PageSpeed Insights, Sucuri, or similar—and how you like to structure ongoing support. I’m ready to start as soon as I find the right match.

item.title: Website Gallery & Testimonials Update
item.description:

Here’s what I need done:
• Add a new image gallery in a clean grid layout. I’ll supply the photos; you handle sizing, optimisation and seamless styling so it matches the existing theme. • Insert those same new pictures into the relevant service pages where placeholders currently sit. • Create a reviews & testimonials section that appears prominently on the homepage, styled to fit the site’s colours and typography. I’ll provide the copy; you just need to lay it out attractively and wire it into my CMS so I can add more later.
Everything runs on WordPress with Elementor, so experience with both is important. No major redesign—just tidy, lightweight tweaks that keep load times fast and the user experience smooth. Once complete, I’d like a quick walk-through (screen-share or short Loom video) showing where to update images and testimonials in future.
If you’ve handled similar front-end tweaks before and can turn this around quickly, let’s get started.

item.title: Ongoing SEO, Ads & Site Care
item.description:
8-15 CAD/hr | I need an experienced hand to keep three critical engines of our business running smoothly: our SEO rankings, our Google Ads campaigns, and the overall health of the website itself and consistent communication and reporting.
SEO focus • The immediate KPI is a steady, measurable lift in our domain authority, not just short-term keyword jumps. You’ll monitor and adjust on-page elements, technical SEO, and backlink outreach with tools like Google Search Console, Ahrefs or SEMrush, then translate the data into clear monthly reports I can act on.
Google Ads & AI-driven optimisation • Our campaigns already generate leads locally, but bids, copy and audiences need regular pruning and expansion. Automate wherever sensible with Performance Max or similar AI features while still applying human judgment to keep cost-per-lead under control.
Website maintenance • The site (WordPress with a handful of custom plugins) requires routine updates, uptime checks, speed improvements and security patches so rankings and ads never suffer from a surprise outage.
Local market orientation Everything you do should map back to visibility and conversion in our immediate geographic area; national traffic is nice, but local wins pay the bills.
Deliverables each month 1. Domain-authority progress report with actions taken 2. Google Ads performance summary and next-step plan 3. Website maintenance log with any fixes or upgrades applied
If that cadence and scope fit your expertise, let’s talk about timing and onboarding.

item.title: Rustic Horse Boarding Website Integration
item.description:
50+ USD/hr | I operate a horse boarding facility and need a U.S.-based web designer to create a warm, traditional-yet-rustic online home that helps me attract new boarders. The site has to feel welcoming to equestrians while still handling the practical tasks of my business.
Core objectives • Seamlessly connect the website with our existing Facebook and Instagram pages so new posts and photos appear in both directions without extra work. • Offer an immersive, interactive facility tour—panoramas or 360° video—so prospects can “walk the barn” before they call. • Host legal boarding agreements in a secure, digital, sign-and-pay format. Once signed, the form should trigger an invoice through QuickBooks Online, allowing clients to set up monthly auto-pay for stall rent. • Provide a simple dashboard where I can publish or embed articles and videos—whether they come from my own content writer or trusted equine news sites. • Install visitor analytics (e.g., Google Analytics 4 with enhanced tracking or a comparable tool) and a Facebook/Instagram pixel so I can see who drops by even if they never fill out a form. • Build on a platform that lets me expand later with testimonials or photo galleries if I choose, without a full redesign.
Deliverables 1. Fully responsive website styled in a traditional, rustic aesthetic. 2. Integrated social feeds (FB & IG) with auto-sync capabilities. 3. Digital boarding agreement workflow tied directly to QuickBooks Online for invoicing and recurring payments. 4. Interactive 360° or video-based facility tour embedded on the site. 5. Content management area for articles and videos with copy-paste simplicity. 6. Visitor tracking setup with clear reporting instructions. 7. A brief hand-off guide or live walk-through so I can manage day-to-day updates myself.
I’m open to WordPress, Squarespace, or another stable platform—whichever best supports these functions without heavy custom code. Clean execution, clear communication, and an eye for country charm matter most to me.

item.title: WordPress Relaunch for Animal Welfare Site
item.description:
12-18 EUR/hr | We are a small German nonprofit animal welfare foundation and are looking for an experienced WordPress freelancer to redesign and modernize our existing website:
[www.tierschutzstiftungen.de](http://www.tierschutzstiftungen.de)
The website already contains extensive content and should not be rebuilt completely from scratch. We want a professional WordPress relaunch with a cleaner structure, modern and emotional design, better mobile usability, and a much stronger focus on our animal welfare projects and donations. The payment systems, set up by the previous agency, are working fine and do not require changes.
The current navigation is too extensive and should be simplified considerably. We are considering a structure such as:
Our Foundation | Projects | Animals & Help | News | About Us | DONATE
The DONATE button should be clearly visible.
The homepage should feature a large emotional animal image, our foundation name, and our message:
“Without detours – directly for the benefit of animals.”
It should then present a small number of current projects with strong images and short descriptions, followed by measurable impact, animal stories, information about the foundation, and a clear donation call to action.
Our current projects include support for an animal shelter in Andratx, food and supply donations, support for an animal clinic, and the care of cats and donkeys in Mallorca as well as animal welfare projects in Germany.
The donation page should also be redesigned to become a real donation landing page, explaining clearly what donations achieve and making it easy for visitors to support our work.
We are looking specifically for a freelancer with:
- Strong WordPress and Elementor experience - Experience with NGO, nonprofit or charity websites - Good UI/UX and web design skills - Experience with German or European clients - Responsive/mobile design experience - Basic SEO and performance optimization - Ability to work with our existing WordPress website - Ability to create a homepage mockup before full implementation
We prefer an individual freelancer or very small team rather than a large agency.
Please provide 2–3 examples of NGO/nonprofit websites and, if possible, websites created for German or European clients.

item.title: Full-Service Amazon Store Management
item.description:
8-15 USD/hr | We're launching an Amazon store and need a comprehensive, end-to-end management service. We need you to build out the store design per our concepts. And then expert marketing to drive visibility and sales. Mainly clothing, accessories, home & living items.
Requirements: - Store setup and product listing: We need an appealing and optimized store, with all products listed professionally from the get-go. - Product sourcing: We expect high-quality, trendy clothing that's competitively priced. - Inventory management: Efficient tracking and management of stock levels. - Customer service and returns: Excellent customer service to handle inquiries and returns promptly and professionally.
Ideal Skills: - Proven experience in e-commerce, particularly on Amazon - Strong background in marketing and promotions - Excellent inventory management skills - Customer service expertise - Proven positive track record with end to end Amazon store management. - Experience with Printful to Amazon integrations (Not required but useful)
We will be using Printful as our print-on-demand and dropshipping service. It integrates with Amazon. Please familiarize yourself with that platform.
